title: X-ray Diffraction Pattern Analysis Software — Overview and definition
t: X-ray Diffraction Pattern Analysis Software — Overview and definition
description: Identifies phases and quantifies crystallography from diffraction data.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Identifies phases and quantifies crystallography from diffraction data. XRD analysis software indexes peaks, identifies phases against ICDD/PDF databases, refines structures by Rietveld, and measures crystallite size and strain. Real implementations include HighScore, Jade, TOPAS, and GSAS-II. It handles texture, residual stress, and thin-film geometries.

t: X-ray Diffraction Pattern Analysis Software — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Identifies phases and quantifies crystallography from diffraction data.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for X-ray Diffraction Pattern Analysis Software, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Phase identification against reference databases). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Phase identification against reference databases and Rietveld refinement with goodness-of-fit. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Crystal structure modeling tool) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
